1082	in mortal danger, understanding that he is utterly helpless,
1083	completely without the Master of the World. And so in these two
1084	cases there is no danger of the leaven in the dough,
1085	the yetzer hara, taking him to a bad place. What happens is
1086	that the yetzer hara

1089	in that state of unequivocal insight that he

1091	who must bring a thanksgiving offering, or in the case of
1092	the Torah at the giving of the Torah, that the Torah is a spice against the yetzer
1093	hara. And this really brings us into the depth of the matter
1094	of chametz and matzah. So, as said, regarding the sacrifices we are speaking
1095	of Jerusalem while the Beit HaMikdash stands. But every
1096	Jew, every Jew is obligated in this matter of what?
1097	Of eating matzah and keeping chametz away
1098	during the days of Pesach. Seven days in the Land of Israel,
1099	eight days outside the Land, in which there is no chametz.
1100	You need this in order to receive balance. As
1101	the Ramchal says,
1102	from the moment you have these seven or eight days,
1103	you are inoculated for the whole year. Of course, on condition that the whole
1104	year is also lived within Torah and within its understandings,
1105	because on your own you do not understand what is permitted and forbidden.
1106	Many times you think you are fine and you do not
1107	realize that in truth the yetzer hara is leading you. So in order
1108	to understand, you need the Torah, which is a spice
1109	against it. But on the technical level, because he is speaking here
1110	about the body, understand once more, he said that the matzah
1111	enables the body to be in a state of sacrifice and holiness.
